findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed two boxes of cups on the floor in the storage space for Wednesday night meals. The boxes of cups were moved up off of the floor. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

(A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
There is observed a damaged floor tile by the floor drain near the triple sink.  Ensure tile is removed and replaced or repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, easily cleanable surface.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a damaged floor tile by the floor drain near the triple sink. Ensure this tile is removed and replaced or repaired to crate a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
REPEATX2-There are rusty areas around the faucets on the 3 compartment sink. Sand and seal the rusty areas.
750-260 Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging or by easily cleanable serving line or salad bar protector devices, display cases or by other effective means.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
REPEAT-Pans and bowls were stored food side up and uncovered in the room with the stoves. Store pans and bowls inverted and/or covered.
750-860 The food-contact surfaces of fixed equipment shall also be  protected from contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.  The wood bracing the plumbing below the 3-pan sink is raw wood.  Paint the wood so it is non-absorbent and easily cleanable.
2.  There are rusty areas around the faucets on the 3-pan sink.  (REPEAT VIOLATION - recorded as a #37 last inspection).    Sand and seal the rusty areas.                  750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The place where attachments fit on the floor mixer was soiled with oil.  Clean and sanitize the attachment area.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Pans and bowls were stored food side up and uncovered in the room with the stoves.   Store the pans and bowls inverted and /or covered.

750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the ovens and in the corner behind the upright Garland oven was soiled.  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
A light bulb was burnt out in the hood over the ovens.  Replace the bulb.

750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.
